source: Prompt caching and context reuse. Repeated large context can sometimes be cached to reduce cost or latency, but cache identity and authorization become part of correctness. Just-in-time agentic search. Agents can keep lightweight references and load information only when needed rather than preloading all potentially relevant context; this belongs to the broader context-engineering problem. Structured and multimodal ZXNAME0000XZ. SQL, knowledge graphs, tables, images, and code often need retrieval or tool interfaces that preserve structure instead of flattening everything into text chunks. Abstention and answerability. A production system should distinguish ’no relevant evidence found’ from ’evidence found but insufficient/conflicting’ and test whether the model declines appropriately.
zh: 提示缓存和上下文重用。有时可以缓存重复的大型上下文以降低成本或延迟，但缓存身份和授权成为正确性的一部分。即时代理搜索。代理可以保留轻量级引用并仅在需要时加载信息，而不是预加载所有潜在相关的上下文；这属于更广泛的上下文工程问题。结构化和多模式 ZXNAME0000XZ。 SQL、知识图、表格、图像和代码通常需要保留结构的检索或工具接口，而不是将所有内容扁平化为文本块。弃权和问责。生产系统应区分“未找到相关证据”和“找到证据但不充分/冲突”，并测试模型是否适当下降。
